absentComponent.en: The absent proposed-order component is the order portion of “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” (official form ID ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS) for the Act 346 first-offender dismiss-and-seal route.
absentComponent.es: El componente ausente de orden propuesta es la parte de la orden de “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” (identificador oficial ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS) para la ruta de desestimación y sellado para primeros infractores bajo la Ley 346.

specificReason.en: The current official PDF is not included in this packet, and the ACIC uniform petition-and-order pair governs this component. These instructions therefore do not draft replacement order language.
specificReason.es: El PDF oficial vigente no está incluido en este paquete, y el par uniforme de petición y orden de ACIC rige este componente. Por eso, estas instrucciones no redactan texto de orden para sustituirlo.

destination.name: Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC) / Arkansas Department of Public Safety
destination.en: The official destination for the missing “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” is the Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC), within the Arkansas Department of Public Safety; use its criminal-history forms index.
destination.es: El destino oficial para obtener “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation”, que está ausente, es el Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC), dentro del Arkansas Department of Public Safety; use su índice de formularios de antecedentes penales.

nextAction.en: Use the ACIC criminal-history forms index to obtain the current official order portion identified as ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS and keep it with its matching petition portion.
nextAction.es: Use el índice de formularios de antecedentes penales de ACIC para obtener la parte vigente de la orden oficial identificada como ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS y manténgala junto con la parte correspondiente de la petición.

en: The current official order portion of “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” from the ACIC forms index.
The matching current official petition portion from that ACIC pair.
es: La parte vigente de la orden oficial de “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” obtenida del índice de formularios de ACIC.
La parte correspondiente de la petición oficial vigente de ese par de ACIC.

en: Do not draft or file substitute order language in place of the ACIC order.
Do not treat the petition portion alone as including this separate proposed-order component.
es: No presente ni redacte texto de orden sustituto en lugar de la orden de ACIC.
No trate la parte de la petición por sí sola como si incluyera este componente separado de orden propuesta.

packetAbsenceDisclosure.en: This packet does not include the proposed order component “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” (ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS); you must obtain the current official component from ACIC.
packetAbsenceDisclosure.es: Este paquete no incluye el componente de orden propuesta “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” (ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS); usted debe obtener de ACIC el componente oficial vigente.

en: Your answers already saved for the Act 346 first-offender dismiss-and-seal route must remain in your Briefcase.

Any documents already saved for this route must remain attached to the same Briefcase item while “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” is outstanding.
es: Sus respuestas ya guardadas para la ruta de desestimación y sellado para primeros infractores bajo la Ley 346 deben permanecer en su Briefcase.

Todo documento ya guardado para esta ruta debe permanecer adjunto al mismo elemento de Briefcase mientras esté pendiente “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation”.

en: Obtain the current official “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” identified by ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS.
Add that exact official component to the saved Act 346 first-offender dismiss-and-seal route before continuing.
es: Obtenga la versión oficial vigente de “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” identificada por ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS.
Agregue ese componente oficial exacto a la ruta de desestimación y sellado para primeros infractores bajo la Ley 346 guardada antes de continuar.

return.en: After you obtain the exact ACIC component, return to the saved Act 346 first-offender dismiss-and-seal route in your Briefcase, add it there, and continue from that same item.
return.es: Después de obtener el componente exacto de ACIC, regrese en su Briefcase a la ruta de desestimación y sellado para primeros infractores bajo la Ley 346 guardada, agréguelo allí y continúe desde ese mismo elemento.

payment.en: Checkout for the missing “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” component must remain unavailable, and you must not be charged for it.
payment.es: La opción de pago para el componente ausente “ACIC Petition and Order to Dismiss and Seal First Offenders, plus the Order of Probation” debe permanecer no disponible; no se le cobre ningún pago por este componente.

credit.en: No packet credit or partner packet credit may be consumed for the missing ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS component.
credit.es: No se puede consumir ningún crédito de paquete ni crédito de paquete del socio por el componente ausente ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS.

escalation.actor: Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC) / Arkansas Department of Public Safety
escalation.en: If the exact current order identified as ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS is not available through the ACIC index, ask the Arkansas Crime Information Center / Department of Public Safety how to obtain the matching order before proceeding.
escalation.es: Si la orden vigente exacta identificada como ACIC-ORDER-DISMISS-AND-SEAL-FIRST-OFFENDERS no está disponible por medio del índice de ACIC, pregunte al Arkansas Crime Information Center / Department of Public Safety cómo obtener la orden correspondiente antes de continuar.
